other_conditions: Beneficiary must be a differently abled person
Beneficiary must be studying in government-recognized schools, colleges or training centers
Beneficiary must have obtained not less than 40% marks in the previous qualifying examination
Beneficiary must be enrolled in one of the following courses: 9th to 12th Standard, Degree Courses, Postgraduate, Medical, Engineering, Vocational, or Other Professional Courses
benefits_summary: Provides annual scholarship of ₹4,000 for 9th‑12th Standard students, ₹6,000 for degree courses, and ₹7,000 for postgraduate and professional courses.
